verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs include an API reference section: webhook reference pages sit under an /api-explorer/ path, and a docs page shows API endpoint schemas and examples embedded in guides via <ApiSchema> and <ApiExample> components. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run from the browser (no 'try it' console or live request execution). Missing for 10: evidence of runnable/try-it requests, interactive request building with auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: This page demonstrates how to embed API endpoint schemas and examples directly in user guides using the `<ApiSchema>` and `<ApiExample>` components.
